text:
Anika (CEO): Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands — appreciate the great questions. Recording + slides: https://redwood.ai/ah/2026-03-23 (org access). I'll drop quick clarifications here and capture action items. :tada:

Priya (VP Product): Quick clarifs — 1) When does Dedicated SLA kick in for pilot customers? 2) Where's the migration checklist?

Anika (CEO): SLA targets: soft start 2026-05-15, firm SLA 2026-06-01. Migration checklist lives in Confluence but will add a short runbook link below.

Marco (Eng Manager): I'll own the runbook. Is there an accepted format? I can mirror the Dedicated -> Private checklist we used previously.

Priya (VP Product): Thanks Marco. Format: short steps + verification + rollback. Customer-facing FAQ should be a separate doc.

Lina (SRE): Re: SLOs/alerts — we need a run-through of what metrics the console will expose (p99 latency, error-rate per-route, cost-per-token). Can infra own a draft?

Sam (PM): I can draft the customer FAQ and comms. Need product owners to approve tone.

Devon (CTO): Ops: Marco + Lina to align on verification steps. Priya + Sam will own customer-facing comms. I'll review SLA wording before publish.

Marco (Eng Manager): Noted. I'll create the runbook and a short checklist in the repo.

Anika (CEO): To make this actionable — adding items below. I'll check progress in the next weekly sync.

ops-bot: New calendar event created: "AH follow-ups: Dedicated rollout sync" — 2026-03-30 10:00 PST. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/ah-followups-1934512345

```
Action items:
- Marco (Eng Manager) -> create dedicated-migration-runbook (#JIRA-2140) due 2026-04-10
- Lina (SRE) -> draft SLO + alerting playbook (#JIRA-2201) due 2026-04-07
- Sam (PM) -> customer FAQ + comms draft (link to doc) due 2026-04-05
- Priya (VP Product) -> review and approve customer FAQ due 2026-04-09
- Devon (CTO) -> sign-off SLA wording by 2026-04-12
- Anika (CEO) -> verify rollout cadence in weekly sync on 2026-03-30
```

Priya (VP Product): Also requested a small budget for two contractor security reviews for Private deployment — @Finance please advise next steps. :money_with_wings:

Marco (Eng Manager): FYI I'll open the JIRA tasks tonight and link runbook in the ticket.

Lina (SRE): I'll prototype the alert pages in Console and share screenshots in #eng-sre before 2026-04-07.

Sam (PM): Customer comms draft will include an FAQ, migration timeline, and opt-in instructions. I'll post a link here when ready.

Devon (CTO): Thanks everyone. If there are blockers, please ping me directly.

Anika (CEO): Closing loop — will follow-up on ownership at next sync. Great momentum, team. :rocket:
